lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three distinct horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters are visible posterior to the gill slits. The medial row features the largest and most regularly spaced centroids, while the dorsal rows consist of smaller, more frequent local maxima.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a grid-like arrangement of nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal ridge is located in the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with a highlighted dorsal edge and a shadowed ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A dark, localized protrusion or lesion is visible in the mid-flank region. Multiple remoras are attached to the lateral dermis and the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a dense, irregular clustering of small high-luminance spots, contrasting with the organized distribution on the primary flank.
